planning_notes: ImpactReport was treated as authoritative. Targeted ranges were inspected for all affected package manifests, Solr XML/config files, direct Solr helper files, and representative Solr caller ranges. Whole files were not read except that rg confirmed no npm lockfiles were present. Npm target versions were checked with npm view on 2026-08-01. Official Apache Solr download/news pages checked on 2026-08-01 list Solr 10.0.0 as the most recent release and Solr 9.10.1 as the last 9.x release: https://solr.apache.org/downloads and https://solr.apache.org/news.html. Because this repository has no Solr image/service manifest and has Solr 4.x-era config, the executable compatibility target is Solr 9.10.1; moving to Solr 10.0.0 is flagged as unknown until the migrated schema/config and direct HTTP select/update clients are proven against that runtime. The setup command intentionally uses npm install --no-package-lock because no lockfiles currently exist; creating lockfiles would be a scope expansion. User-supplied startup commands were converted to bounded PowerShell wrappers with the supplied health_check_url values. User-supplied CLI commands are recorded exactly and must fail validation on any nonzero exit. Package replacement for deprecated/latest-equal packages such as request, ftp, pace, and optimist is outside this plan unless a declared validation command fails and the executor documents a narrow repair. Scope revised after executor feedback: Admin/API/admin-usage.js, tv-radio-frontend/metrics.js, and Common/directdb-mongo.js are approved dependency-compatibility scope expansions for Influx 5 and MongoDB 7 failures surfaced by bounded startup validation. Startup command log redirection was moved to the artifact directory to avoid committing transient logs.
plan_summary: Plan updates eight npm manifests, migrates Solr schema/config from 4.x-era settings toward Solr 9.10.1 compatibility, preserves direct Solr helper APIs and configured /select and /update paths, and validates with bounded Admin API/frontend startup plus all user-supplied CLI index-maintenance commands. Revised after execution feedback to include Admin/API/app.js Express 5 static MIME compatibility via mime-types. Revised again to include Influx 5 writePoints payload compatibility and MongoDB 7 adapter compatibility surfaced by executor startup checks.
